WITH february_all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    visitStartTime,
    device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201702*`
),
february_sessions_with_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    visitStartTime,
    device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201702*`
  WHERE totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM february_all_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_transaction_date
  FROM february_sessions_with_transactions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_txn_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fs.fullVisitorId,
    fs.date,
    fs.deviceCategory,
    fs.visitId,
    fs.visitNumber,
    fs.visitStartTime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY fs.fullVisitorId ORDER BY fs.visitStartTime ASC) as rn
  FROM february_sessions_with_transactions fs
  INNER JOIN first_transaction ft 
    ON fs.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId 
    AND fs.date = ft.first_transaction_date
)
SELECT 
  fts.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  fts.date as first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fts.date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  fts.deviceCategory
FROM first_txn_sessions fts
JOIN first_visit fv ON fts.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
WHERE fts.rn = 1
ORDER BY fts.fullVisitorId

WITH daily_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source,
    date AS hit_date,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 AS daily_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, 
  UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source, hit_date
),
top_source AS (
  SELECT source
  FROM daily_revenue
  GROUP BY source
  ORDER BY SUM(daily_revenue_millions) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
source_daily AS (
  SELECT d.source, d.hit_date, d.daily_revenue_millions
  FROM daily_revenue d
  JOIN top_source t ON d.source = t.source
),
max_daily AS (
  SELECT MAX(daily_revenue_millions) AS max_daily_millions
  FROM source_daily
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    d.source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', d.hit_date), WEEK) AS week_start,
    SUM(d.daily_revenue_millions) AS weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM source_daily d
  GROUP BY d.source, week_start
),
max_weekly AS (
  SELECT MAX(weekly_revenue_millions) AS max_weekly_millions
  FROM weekly_revenue
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    d.source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', d.hit_date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(d.daily_revenue_millions) AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM source_daily d
  GROUP BY d.source, month_start
),
max_monthly AS (
  SELECT MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) AS max_monthly_millions
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  t.source AS traffic_source,
  md.max_daily_millions AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  mw.max_weekly_millions AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  mm.max_monthly_millions AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions
FROM top_source t, max_daily md, max_weekly mw, max_monthly mm

-- Try all four months
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  CASE 
    WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN totals.transactions IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as session_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) as num_visitors,
  AVG(totals.pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH page_hits AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.time,
    h.page.pagePath,
    LEAD(h.page.pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS next_page_path,
    LEAD(h.time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
    AND h.page.pagePath IS NOT NULL
    AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT
    next_page_path,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(next_time - time AS FLOAT64), 1000.0) AS time_spent_seconds
  FROM page_hits
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT next_page_path FROM home_hits WHERE next_page_path IS NOT NULL GROUP BY next_page_path ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_next_page,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(time_spent_seconds)) AS INT64) AS max_time_on_home_seconds
FROM home_hits
WHERE time_spent_seconds IS NOT NULL

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1e6 AS monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) AS max_monthly,
  MIN(monthly_revenue_millions) AS min_monthly,
  ROUND(MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) - MIN(monthly_revenue_millions), 2) AS difference
FROM monthly_revenue

-- Find top-selling product (by quantity) among customers who bought 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley' in July 2017, excluding that product itself
WITH customers_who_bought AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`, 
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
    AND p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName AS product_name, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, 
UNNEST(hits) AS h
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
  AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM customers_who_bought)
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH users_with_positive_engagement_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0)
),
users_with_positive_engagement_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_with_positive_engagement_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM users_with_positive_engagement_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id
)

SELECT 
  date,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
  cumulative_confirmed,
  LAG(cumulative_confirmed) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY date) as prev_cumulative,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_confirmed - LAG(cumulative_confirmed) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY date), LAG(cumulative_confirmed) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY date)) as growth_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds >= 0
    AND trip_seconds <= 3600
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  CAST(ROUND(MIN(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS INT64) AS min_duration_minutes,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS INT64) AS max_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
  cw.census_tract_geoid AS geo_id,
  ROUND(AVG(f.transaction_amt), 2) AS avg_donation,
  acs.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` f
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` cw
  ON SUBSTR(f.zip_code, 1, 5) = cw.zip_code
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` acs
  ON cw.census_tract_geoid = acs.geo_id
WHERE f.state = 'NY' 
  AND cw.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
  AND f.transaction_amt > 0
GROUP BY geo_id, acs.median_income
ORDER BY geo_id

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    CAST(p.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot) as total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot) as total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number 
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
),
max_acres_per_group AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    total_subplot_acres,
    total_macroplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  state_code,
  total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres,
  total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM max_acres_per_group
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(CAST(year AS INT64), CAST(mo AS INT64), CAST(da AS INT64)) AS date,
    ROUND((temp - 32) * 5.0/9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444, 1) AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290'
    AND CAST(year AS INT64) = 2019
    AND CAST(mo AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER w, 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM rochester_data
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY date)
),
with_lags AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    temp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag1,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag1,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag1,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag2,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag2,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag2,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag3,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag3,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag3,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag4,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag4,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag4,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag5,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag5,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag5,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag6,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag6,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag6,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag7,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag7,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag7,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER w, 1) AS temp_diff_lag8,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER w, 1) AS prcp_diff_lag8,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER w, 1) AS wdsp_diff_lag8
  FROM with_ma
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY date)
)
SELECT * FROM with_lags
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * ACOS(
      LEAST(
        GREATEST(
          SIN(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(e.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) 
          + COS(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(e.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) 
          * COS((e.longitude - s.longitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180),
          -1
        ),
        1
      )
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` e ON t.end_station_id = e.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC

-- Good - 41126 group rides for station 2006, which matches. 
-- Now let me produce the final clean result. The question asks for:
-- 1. Station name or identifier
-- 2. Proportion of group rides (decimal)

-- I'll use the station name from the citibike_stations table when available, otherwise from trips.
-- Let me produce the final result.

WITH same_station_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        starttime,
        FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) / 2) * 2 as two_min_window,
        DATE(starttime) as trip_date
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
station_window_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        two_min_window,
        trip_date,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM same_station_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id, two_min_window, trip_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
group_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        s.start_station_id
    FROM same_station_trips s
    JOIN station_window_groups g
        ON s.start_station_id = g.start_station_id
        AND s.two_min_window = g.two_min_window
        AND s.trip_date = g.trip_date
),
total_trips_per_station AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        end_station_name,
        COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
),
station_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        SUM(total_trips_ending) as total_trips_ending
    FROM total_trips_per_station
    GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        end_station_name,
        SUM(total_trips_ending) as total_trips_ending
    FROM total_trips_per_station
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
)
SELECT 
    t.end_station_id as station_id,
    COALESCE(s.name, n.end_station_name) as station_name,
    COUNT(*) as group_rides,
    t.total_trips_ending,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), t.total_trips_ending), 4) as proportion
FROM group_trips g
JOIN station_totals t
    ON g.start_station_id = t.end_station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s
    ON CAST(g.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
JOIN station_names n
    ON g.start_station_id = n.end_station_id
GROUP BY t.end_station_id, s.name, n.end_station_name, t.total_trips_ending
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', date) as month,
  SUM(volume_sold_liters) as total_liters,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(volume_sold_liters), 9882) as per_capita_liters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
WHERE county = 'DUBUQUE'
  AND category_name = 'STRAIGHT BOURBON WHISKIES'
  AND CAST(CAST(zip_code AS FLOAT64) AS STRING) = '52003'
  AND date >= '2022-01-01' 
  AND date < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH weather AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value / 10.0 as precipitation_mm,
    CASE WHEN value / 10.0 > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_condition
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025'
    AND element = 'PRCP'
    AND qflag IS NULL
),
trip_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT 
  w.weather_condition,
  COUNT(*) as days_in_category,
  SUM(tc.num_trips) as total_trips,
  AVG(tc.num_trips) as avg_daily_trips
FROM weather w
INNER JOIN trip_counts tc ON w.date = tc.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition
ORDER BY w.weather_condition

WITH 
-- Count living (not dead) trees per species in 1995
t1995 AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin NOT IN ('PLANTING SITE', 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'STUMP', 'PINUS SPECIES')
    AND status != 'Dead'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Count alive trees per species in 2015
t2015 AS (
  SELECT UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
    AND status = 'Alive'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Join with tree_species to get fall_color
matched_species AS (
  SELECT 
    ts.species_scientific_name,
    ts.fall_color,
    COALESCE(t1995.cnt, 0) as cnt_1995,
    COALESCE(t2015.cnt, 0) as cnt_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts
  LEFT JOIN t1995 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = t1995.upper_spc
  LEFT JOIN t2015 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = t2015.upper_spc
  WHERE COALESCE(t1995.cnt, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(t2015.cnt, 0) > 0
)
SELECT 
  fall_color,
  SUM(cnt_1995) as total_1995,
  SUM(cnt_2015) as total_2015,
  SUM(cnt_1995 - cnt_2015) as change
FROM matched_species
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH c1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '') AS base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(1) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Poor') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '')
),
c2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin_upper,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '') AS base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(1) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(spc_latin), r"\s+(VAR\.|X|'[^']*')(.*)", '')
),
agg1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(total_count) AS total_count,
    SUM(alive_count) AS alive_count,
    SUM(dead_count) AS dead_count
  FROM c1995
  GROUP BY base_latin
),
agg2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    base_latin,
    ARRAY_AGG(spc_common ORDER BY spc_common LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS spc_common,
    SUM(total_count) AS total_count,
    SUM(alive_count) AS alive_count,
    SUM(dead_count) AS dead_count
  FROM c2015
  GROUP BY base_latin
)
SELECT 
  a.base_latin AS spc_latin_upper,
  COALESCE(b.spc_common, a.spc_common) AS spc_common,
  a.total_count AS total_1995,
  b.total_count AS total_2015,
  a.alive_count AS alive_1995,
  b.alive_count AS alive_2015,
  a.dead_count AS dead_1995,
  b.dead_count AS dead_2015,
  b.total_count - a.total_count AS growth_total,
  b.alive_count - a.alive_count AS growth_alive,

FROM agg1995 a

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '53'
    AND ST_DISTANCE(

intersection AS (
  SELECT

-- Compute Pearson correlation for each year using CORR function
WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS as fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_Desc = 'None checked' THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as births_no_morbidity,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year), County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id as fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE poverty IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id as fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE poverty IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id as fips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE poverty IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status IS NOT NULL AND pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
joined AS (
  SELECT n.year, n.fips, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births) * 100 as pct_no_morbidity,
         CASE n.year
           WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate_pct
         END as poverty_rate_pct
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON n.fips = c2015.fips AND n.year = 2016
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON n.fips = c2016.fips AND n.year = 2017
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON n.fips = c2017.fips AND n.year = 2018
  WHERE n.total_births > 0
    AND CASE n.year
           WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate_pct
           WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate_pct
         END IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  year,
  CORR(pct_no_morbidity, poverty_rate_pct) as pearson_correlation,
  COUNT(*) as num_counties
FROM joined
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH latest_eval AS (

    state_code,
    MAX(evaluation_group) as latest_eval_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY state_code
),
filtered_conditions AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_code,
    c.state_code_name,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
    p.expansion_factor,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    p.evaluation_group,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 
      THEN p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
      THEN p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted
      ELSE 0
    END as adjusted_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  JOIN latest_eval le 
    ON c.state_code = le.state_code AND p.evaluation_group = le.latest_eval_group
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
state_totals AS (

    SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 THEN adjusted_acres ELSE 0 END) as forestland_acres
  FROM filtered_conditions
  GROUP BY state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group
),

  FROM state_totals
),

-- Final chi-squared calculation using clinical-mutation matched PAAD patients
WITH kras_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    WHERE m.Study = 'PAAD' AND m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS'
),
tp53_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    WHERE m.Study = 'PAAD' AND m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53'
),
all_paad_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    WHERE m.Study = 'PAAD'
),
contingency AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT ap.patient_id) as total,
        COUNT(DISTINCT k.patient_id) as kras_pos,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.patient_id) as tp53_pos,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN k.patient_id IS NOT NULL AND t.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN ap.patient_id END) as both,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN k.patient_id IS NOT NULL AND t.patient_id IS NULL THEN ap.patient_id END) as kras_only,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN k.patient_id IS NULL AND t.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN ap.patient_id END) as tp53_only,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN k.patient_id IS NULL AND t.patient_id IS NULL THEN ap.patient_id END) as neither
    FROM all_paad_patients ap
    LEFT JOIN kras_patients k ON ap.patient_id = k.patient_id
    LEFT JOIN tp53_patients t ON ap.patient_id = t.patient_id
)
SELECT 
    total, kras_pos, tp53_pos, both, kras_only, tp53_only, neither,
    ROUND(chi_squared_stat, 6) as chi_squared_stat
FROM (
    SELECT *,
        SAFE_DIVIDE((both - SAFE_DIVIDE(kras_pos * tp53_pos, total)) * (both - SAFE_DIVIDE(kras_pos * tp53_pos, total)), SAFE_DIVIDE(kras_pos * tp53_pos, total)) +
        SAFE_DIVIDE((kras_only - SAFE_DIVIDE(kras_pos * (total - tp53_pos), total)) * (kras_only - SAFE_DIVIDE(kras_pos * (total - tp53_pos), total)), SAFE_DIVIDE(kras_pos * (total - tp53_pos), total)) +
        SAFE_DIVIDE((tp53_only - SAFE_DIVIDE((total - kras_pos) * tp53_pos, total)) * (tp53_only - SAFE_DIVIDE((total - kras_pos) * tp53_pos, total)), SAFE_DIVIDE((total - kras_pos) * tp53_pos, total)) +
        SAFE_DIVIDE((neither - SAFE_DIVIDE((total - kras_pos) * (total - tp53_pos), total)) * (neither - SAFE_DIVIDE((total - kras_pos) * (total - tp53_pos), total)), SAFE_DIVIDE((total - kras_pos) * (total - tp53_pos), total)) as chi_squared_stat
    FROM contingency
)

-- Build the final result: imaging assay types at WUSTL with their available levels
WITH wustl_level2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT il.Imaging_Assay_Type, il.entityId
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level2_metadata_r5` il
  WHERE il.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
    AND il.Imaging_Assay_Type IS NOT NULL
    AND il.Imaging_Assay_Type NOT LIKE '%Electron%'
),
wustl_level3 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ip.entityId, ip.Component
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` ip
  WHERE ip.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
    AND ip.Component = 'ImagingLevel3Segmentation'
),
wustl_level4 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ip.entityId, ip.Component
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` ip
  WHERE ip.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
    AND ip.Component = 'ImagingLevel4'
),
-- For each assay type, determine which levels are available
all_levels AS (
  SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level2' as data_level
  FROM wustl_level2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level3' as data_level
  FROM wustl_level2 w2
  JOIN wustl_level3 w3 ON w2.entityId = w3.entityId
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level4' as data_level
  FROM wustl_level2 w2
  JOIN wustl_level4 w4 ON w2.entityId = w4.entityId
)
SELECT 
  Imaging_Assay_Type,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT data_level, ', ' ORDER BY data_level) as available_levels
FROM all_levels
GROUP BY Imaging_Assay_Type
ORDER BY Imaging_Assay_Type

WITH filtered_samples AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo 
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` 
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
cyto_data AS (
  SELECT cy.Chr, cy.ChrOrd, cy.Start, cy.`End`, cy.Type, cb.cytoband_name, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cy
  JOIN filtered_samples fs ON cy.RefNo = fs.RefNo AND cy.CaseNo = fs.CaseNo
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb ON cy.Chr = cb.chromosome AND cy.Start >= cb.hg38_start AND cy.Start < cb.hg38_stop
),
band_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    cytoband_name,
    ChrOrd,
    hg38_start,
    hg38_stop,
    Type,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM cyto_data
  GROUP BY cytoband_name, ChrOrd, hg38_start, hg38_stop, Type
),
band_totals AS (
  SELECT cytoband_name, ChrOrd, hg38_start, hg38_stop, SUM(count) as total
  FROM band_type_counts
  GROUP BY cytoband_name, ChrOrd, hg38_start, hg38_stop
)
SELECT 
  bt.cytoband_name,
  bt.ChrOrd,
  bt.hg38_start,
  bt.hg38_stop,
  MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Gain' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END) as amplifications,
  0 as gains,
  MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Loss' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END) as losses,
  0 as homozygous_deletions,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Gain' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END), bt.total) * 100, 2) as amplification_freq,
  0.0 as gain_freq,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN btc.Type = 'Loss' THEN btc.count ELSE 0 END), bt.total) * 100, 2) as loss_freq,
  0.0 as homozygous_deletion_freq
FROM band_type_counts btc
JOIN band_totals bt ON bt.cytoband_name = btc.cytoband_name AND bt.ChrOrd = btc.ChrOrd AND bt.hg38_start = btc.hg38_start AND bt.hg38_stop = btc.hg38_stop
GROUP BY bt.cytoband_name, bt.ChrOrd, bt.hg38_start, bt.hg38_stop, bt.total
ORDER BY bt.ChrOrd, bt.hg38_start

WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `end` as EndPos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 48481890 AND `end` > 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `end` as EndPos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 7687490 AND `end` > 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `end` as EndPos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start < 108369102 AND `end` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  WHERE c13.rn = 1
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT c17.RefNo, c17.CaseNo, c17.InvNo, c17.Clone
  FROM chr17_loss c17
  WHERE c17.rn = 1
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT c11.RefNo, c11.CaseNo, c11.InvNo, c11.Clone
  FROM chr11_gain c11
  WHERE c11.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  mc.RefNo,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  c13.ChrOrd as Chr13_ChromOrd,
  c13.Start as Chr13_Start,
  c13.EndPos as Chr13_End,
  c17.ChrOrd as Chr17_ChromOrd,
  c17.Start as Chr17_Start,
  c17.EndPos as Chr17_End,
  c11.ChrOrd as Chr11_ChromOrd,
  c11.Start as Chr11_Start,
  c11.EndPos as Chr11_End,
  kc.CloneShort as KaryClone_Short
FROM matching_clones mc
LEFT JOIN chr13_loss c13 
  ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone AND c13.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr17_loss c17 
  ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone AND c17.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr11_gain c11 
  ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone AND c11.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc 
  ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone

WITH first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) as year_month,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) as rn_asc,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT 
  year_month,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MIN(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) as first_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MIN(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) as last_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(duration_sec), 60) as highest_duration_min,

WITH station_counts AS (

),
entrance_counts AS (

WITH yearly_sales AS (

pivoted AS (

WITH top5_2008 AS (

  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
annual_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
),
category_yearly AS (
  SELECT 
    c.year,
    c.minor_category,

  WHERE c.minor_category IN (SELECT minor_category FROM top5_2008)

)
SELECT 
  year,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Other Theft' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS other_theft_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS theft_from_motor_vehicle_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Possession Of Drugs' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS possession_of_drugs_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Burglary in a Dwelling' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS burglary_in_dwelling_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN minor_category = 'Assault with Injury' THEN category_crimes END), MAX(total_crimes)) * 100, 2) AS assault_with_injury_pct

WITH first_visit AS (

SELECT

  ON ST_WITHIN(p.port_geom, s.state_geom)

  ON ST_DWITHIN(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(h.usa_longitude, h.usa_latitude),

      100000
    )
  )

  AND h.basin = 'NA'

-- Calculate daily averages per country for Oct 2023, then compute differences
WITH country_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    s.country,
    g.date,
    AVG(g.max) as avg_max,
    AVG(g.min) as avg_min,
    AVG(g.temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10' AND g.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
    AND g.temp != 9999.9
    AND g.max != 9999.9
    AND g.min != 9999.9
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
  GROUP BY s.country, g.date
)
SELECT 
  us.date,
  ROUND(us.avg_max - uk.avg_max, 1) as diff_max_temp,
  ROUND(us.avg_min - uk.avg_min, 1) as diff_min_temp,
  ROUND(us.avg_temp - uk.avg_temp, 1) as diff_avg_temp
FROM country_daily us
JOIN country_daily uk ON us.date = uk.date
WHERE us.country = 'US' AND uk.country = 'UK'
ORDER BY us.date

WITH 
question_owners AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q

),
accepted_answers AS (

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.accepted_answer_id = a.id
  WHERE q.post_type_id = 1 AND q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
),
high_score_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE q.post_type_id = 1 AND a.score > 5
),
question_total_scores AS (
  SELECT parent_id AS question_id, SUM(score) AS total_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`

),
threshold_answers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.parent_id AS question_id, a.owner_user_id AS user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
  JOIN question_total_scores qts ON a.parent_id = qts.question_id
  WHERE qts.total_score > 0

ranked_answers AS (

top3_answers AS (

all_associations AS (

  SELECT user_id, question_id FROM top3_answers

  AND h1.health_val_2017 > 0
  AND h2.health_val_2018 > 0
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(p.year_2018 - p.year_2017, p.year_2017) * 100 > 1
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(h2.health_val_2018 - h1.health_val_2017, h1.health_val_2017) * 100 > 1
  AND p.country_code NOT IN ('WLD', 'LMC', 'EAR', 'SST', 'NAC', 'TEA', 'MEA', 'EAP', 'SSA', 'LAC', 'HIC', 'LIC')

WITH monthly_minutes AS (

    AND subscriber_type IN ('Subscriber', 'Customer')
  GROUP BY month, subscriber_type
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(total_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY subscriber_type ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS customer_cumulative,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN cumulative_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_cumulative
  FROM cumulative
  GROUP BY month
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
  am.month,
  COALESCE(p.customer_cumulative, 0) AS customer_cumulative,
  COALESCE(p.subscriber_cumulative, 0) AS subscriber_cumulative,
  ABS(COALESCE(p.customer_cumulative, 0) - COALESCE(p.subscriber_cumulative, 0)) / 1000.0 AS abs_diff_thousands
FROM all_months am

WITH filtered_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157 
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
all_pe_with_tas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id, pe.uniprot_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ppe ON pe.stable_id = ppe.pe_stable_id
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    WHERE ppe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
      AND p.species = 'Homo sapiens'
),
target_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ap.stable_id
    FROM all_pe_with_tas ap
    WHERE ap.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM filtered_targets)
),
non_target_pe AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ap.stable_id
    FROM all_pe_with_tas ap
    WHERE ap.stable_id NOT IN (SELECT stable_id FROM target_pe)
),
pathway_pe_map AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ppe.pathway_stable_id, ppe.pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ppe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    WHERE ppe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
      AND p.species = 'Homo sapiens'
),
pathway_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ppe.pathway_stable_id,
        p.name as pathway_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN tp.stable_id END) as targets_in,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ntp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ntp.stable_id END) as non_targets_in
    FROM pathway_pe_map ppe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON ppe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    LEFT JOIN target_pe tp ON tp.stable_id = ppe.pe_stable_id
    LEFT JOIN non_target_pe ntp ON ntp.stable_id = ppe.pe_stable_id
    GROUP BY ppe.pathway_stable_id, p.name
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stable_id) FROM target_pe) as total_targets,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stable_id) FROM non_target_pe) as total_non_targets
)
SELECT 
    pc.pathway_stable_id,
    pc.pathway_name,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
        (t.total_targets + t.total_non_targets) * 
        POW(
            (pc.targets_in * (t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in) - 
             (t.total_targets - pc.targets_in) * pc.non_targets_in), 2
        ),
        (pc.targets_in + (t.total_targets - pc.targets_in)) *
        ((t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in) + pc.non_targets_in) *
        (pc.targets_in + pc.non_targets_in) *
        ((t.total_targets - pc.targets_in) + (t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in))
    ), 4) as chi_squared,
    pc.targets_in as targets_within,
    t.total_targets - pc.targets_in as targets_outside,
    pc.non_targets_in as non_targets_within,
    t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in as non_targets_outside
FROM pathway_counts pc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE pc.targets_in > 0
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29`
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.doc_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    vm.heavy_atoms,
    vs.canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN valid_molregnos vm ON a.molregno = vm.molregno
  JOIN valid_smiles vs ON a.molregno = vs.molregno
  WHERE a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
),
act_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, molregno, COUNT(*) as act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dup_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY assay_id, molregno
),
valid_acts AS (
  SELECT q.activity_id, q.assay_id, q.doc_id, q.molregno, q.standard_type, 
         q.standard_value, q.standard_relation, q.heavy_atoms, q.canonical_smiles
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN act_counts ac ON q.assay_id = ac.assay_id AND q.molregno = ac.molregno
  WHERE ac.act_count < 5 AND ac.dup_count < 2
),
multi_mol_groups AS (
  SELECT assay_id, standard_type
  FROM valid_acts
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molregno) >= 2
),
filtered_acts AS (
  SELECT va.*

  JOIN multi_mol_groups mmg ON va.assay_id = mmg.assay_id AND va.standard_type = mmg.standard_type

WITH channel_data AS (
  SELECT

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND ep.key = 'ga_session_id'
),

classified AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      -- Direct: Source exactly matches "(direct)" AND Medium is one of ("(not set)", "(none)")
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      
      -- Paid Search: Source matches search sites AND Medium matches ppc/paid/cpc
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex')
        AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      
      -- Organic Search: Source matches search sites OR Medium exactly matches 'organic'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex') 
        OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      
      -- Referral: Medium exactly matches 'referral'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      
      -- Display: Medium is one of display, banner, expandable, interstitial, cpm
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      
      -- Email: Medium = email/e-mail/e_mail/e mail
      WHEN medium IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      
      -- Affiliates: Medium = affiliate
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      
      -- Audio: Medium = audio
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      
      -- SMS: Medium = sms
      WHEN medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      
      -- Others
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel,
    ga_session_id
  FROM channel_data
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
)

  COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) as sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sessions DESC

  FROM session_params

),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(SOURCE) = '(direct)' AND TRIM(MEDIUM) IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%push' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%mobile%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'organic' AND LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE)) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') AND (LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%retargeting%' OR LOWER(TRIM(MEDIUM)) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM first_params
  WHERE rn = 1
)

WITH page_views AS (

  FROM page_views
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    ga_session_id,
    event_timestamp,
    parts,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(parts) AS num_parts,
    (LOWER(REPLACE(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(parts) >= 5, parts[OFFSET(3)], ''), '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
     OR LOWER(REPLACE(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(parts) >= 6, parts[OFFSET(4)], ''), '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
     OR LOWER(REPLACE(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(parts) >= 7, parts[OFFSET(5)], ''), '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')) AS has_category,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(parts) >= 5, 
       REGEXP_CONTAINS(parts[ARRAY_LENGTH(parts)-1], r'\+'), 
       FALSE) AS last_has_plus,
    (LOWER(REPLACE(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(parts) >= 5, parts[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(parts)-1)], ''), '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')) AS last_is_category
  FROM parsed
  WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(parts) >= 5
),
with_type AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    ga_session_id,
    event_timestamp,
    CASE 
      WHEN has_category AND last_is_category THEN 'PLP'
      WHEN has_category AND NOT last_has_plus THEN 'PLP'
      WHEN has_category AND last_has_plus AND NOT last_is_category THEN 'PDP'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS page_type
  FROM classified
),
-- For each session, get the max timestamp of any PDP
session_max_pdp_ts AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PDP' THEN event_timestamp ELSE NULL END) AS max_pdp_timestamp
  FROM with_type
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
-- For each PLP, check if there's a PDP with a later timestamp
plp_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    wt.page_location,
    wt.ga_session_id,
    wt.event_timestamp,
    smp.max_pdp_timestamp,
    CASE WHEN smp.max_pdp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND smp.max_pdp_timestamp > wt.event_timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS led_to_pdp
  FROM with_type wt

  WHERE wt.page_type = 'PLP'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_plp,
  SUM(led_to_pdp) AS plp_with_later_pdp,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(led_to_pdp), COUNT(*)) * 100 AS percentage

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') as page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128` e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
    AND e.user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    CASE 
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5 
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)], r'\+')
        AND (
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus[+]Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google[+]Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New[+]2015[+]Logo|Notebooks[+]Journals|Office|Shop[+]by[+]Brand|Small[+]Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
          OR
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus[+]Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google[+]Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New[+]2015[+]Logo|Notebooks[+]Journals|Office|Shop[+]by[+]Brand|Small[+]Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
        )
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)], r'\+')
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)], r'\+')
        AND (
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus[+]Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google[+]Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New[+]2015[+]Logo|Notebooks[+]Journals|Office|Shop[+]by[+]Brand|Small[+]Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
          OR
          REGEXP_CONTAINS(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus[+]Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google[+]Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New[+]2015[+]Logo|Notebooks[+]Journals|Office|Shop[+]by[+]Brand|Small[+]Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
        )
      THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END as display_title
  FROM page_views
),
with_row_num AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn,
    display_title
  FROM classified
),
diff_flag AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    display_title,
    CASE WHEN display_title != LAG(display_title) OVER (ORDER BY rn) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_new_group
  FROM with_row_num
),
grp_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    display_title,
    SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY rn) as grp
  FROM diff_flag
),
merged AS (
  SELECT 
    display_title
  FROM grp_calc
  GROUP BY grp, display_title
  ORDER BY MIN(rn)
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' as user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>') as navigation_flow,
  COUNT(*) as num_steps
FROM merged
